#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int N = 1000000 + 5;
const int MOD = (int)1e9 + 7;

int a[N];
bool vis[N];
int p, k;

int main()
{
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        int ans = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            ans = (long long)ans * p % MOD;
        }
        cout << ans << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        a[i] = (long long)k * i % p;
    }
    int ans = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            int size = 0;
            int j = i;
            int tmp = 1;
            while (!vis[j]) {
                vis[j] = true;
                j = a[j];
                size++;
                tmp = (long long)tmp * k % p;
            }
            if (size == 1) {
                int cnt = k == 1 ? p : 1;
                ans = (long long)ans * cnt % MOD;
            } else {
                assert(tmp == 1);
                ans = (long long)ans * p % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
}
